recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not change DeviceAssociation.associationStatus cardinality for FHIR-32571 unless OO reopens the current R6 DeviceAssociation design, because the current required status plus optional reason is already aligned with the seed and later history.
issue_request: FHIR-32571 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for R4 Device. It asked why associationStatus was optional when a reason could be present, and OO resolved to make Device.associationStatus.value 1..1 while leaving the containing backbone and reason optional.
initial_application: Git commit 57eb8685b7d5cfb40a640bd72b7dcdb7e9ecd71a applied the issue by changing source/device/structuredefinition-Device.xml so Device.associationStatus.value moved from min 0 to min 1. That old Device backbone was later removed as the current DeviceAssociation resource took over this model area.
additional_context: OO WGM minutes page 113674053 corroborates the Jira resolution as making status values mandatory and leaving reason optional. In current source/fhir.ini, deviceassociation=DeviceAssociation is active. Current DeviceAssociation.status is 1..1 and DeviceAssociation.statusReason is 0..*. Later Applied issue FHIR-48532 explicitly revised DeviceAssociation.status/statusReason and added DeviceAssociation.associationStatus as 0..1.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. The current required DeviceAssociation.status preserves the FHIR-32571 intent that a reason is not present without a status, while making the separate DeviceAssociation.associationStatus mandatory would contradict the later final FHIR-48532 decision.

related_jiras.note: Applied R6 issue that made DeviceAssociation.status a required code, left statusReason optional/extensible, and added DeviceAssociation.associationStatus as optional 0..1.

evidence_items.learned: The optional cardinality of the new associationStatus element is a later explicit WG decision and should not be overwritten by the older Device issue.
